sources.title: Deep Dive into LLMs like ChatGPT
sources.blurb: Andrej Karpathy's general-audience walk through how ChatGPT is trained and run: pretraining, tokens, the base model, post-training, hallucination, tools and RL.

sources.title: Let's build GPT: from scratch, in code, spelled out.
